summary: Compensation calculation in motor accident claim; income based on Income Tax Return (Rs.1,98,192 p.a.); precedent from Malarvizhi and Sonigra Juhi Uttamchand; multiplier method applied; compensation recalculated to Rs.24,53,280 from Rs.13,91,300; medical expenses, loss of estate, funeral, consortium included; impugned award modified.
legal_provisions_cited: National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi (2017) 16 SCC 680
Malarvizhi & Ors. v. United India Insurance Co. Ltd. & Ors. (2020) 4 SCC 228
New India Assurance Co. Ltd. v. Sonigra Juhi Uttamchand 2025 SCC OnLine SC 9
final_judgment: Civil appeal allowed; compensation recalculated and enhanced to Rs.24,53,280; impugned award modified accordingly; interest as per Tribunal; pending applications disposed of.
